# useColorScheme

The person's color scheme, the scheme the page shows, and the setter that changes both, for a control of your own. `ColorSchemeToggle` is that control, ready made.

```tsx
import { useColorScheme } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/color-scheme";
```

## Example

```tsx
const { resolved, setScheme } = useColorScheme();
<Switch label="Dark mode" checked={resolved === "dark"} onCheckedChange={(on) => setScheme(on ? "dark" : "light")} />
```

## Usage

It works with or without `ColorSchemeProvider`, with the provider's options when there is one. Before hydration it reports the default scheme, as the server did.

## Returns

`ColorSchemeValue`

## Types

### `ColorSchemeValue`

What `useColorScheme` returns.

```ts
interface ColorSchemeValue {
  /** The person's choice: `light`, `dark` or `system`. */
  scheme: ColorScheme;
  /** The scheme the page shows: `system` resolved through the system's setting. */
  resolved: ResolvedColorScheme;
  /** Keeps a new choice and applies it to the page at once. */
  setScheme: (scheme: ColorScheme) => void;
}
```
